title: Weighted $W^{1,p}$-estimates for Parabolic Equations of Fabes-Kenig-Seraponi singular-degenerate type
summary: We investigate Dirichlet boundary value problems for a class of second-order parabolic equations in divergence-form with coefficient matrices that exhibit singular and degenerate behaviors characterized by a Muckenhoupt weight class. This framework serves as the parabolic analogue to the singular-degenerate elliptic equations pioneered by Fabes, Kenig, and Seraponi.
